subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should OpenClaw move the iPhone Control tab from the current native List direction to the proposed flatter card-based Chat/Talk layout?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but the PR changes the default iOS Control hierarchy after main already moved toward stock SwiftUI lists, so product/design intent is needed before asking for a repaired branch.

options.title: Prefer current native List direction
options.body: Keep the current main direction unless a maintainer explicitly sponsors the card redesign, and close or narrow the paired feature request.

options.title: Sponsor card redesign
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase, use branded typography, preserve current routing, and add before/after simulator proof for design review.

options.title: Request a smaller polish proposal
options.body: Keep Chat/Talk in the native List but ask for a narrower visual hierarchy tweak that composes with the merged row-density work.

recommendation.title: Prefer current native List direction
recommendation.body: Keep the current main direction unless a maintainer explicitly sponsors the card redesign, and close or narrow the paired feature request.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged visual hierarchy and native iOS direction work makes steipete the best routed design-decision owner from the observed history.
